title: Chapter 14: Building A Well
content:
Chapter 14: Building A Well

When unlocking the tool table, Wang Shuo also discovered a "backpack making formula".

If there is no tool bench, the backpack can only be made by learning the blueprint, but with the tool bench, it is automatically unlocked.

[Elementary backpack (coarse cloth bag): 6 coarse cloths + 1 rope]

I thought silently in my mind, "Make a beginner's backpack."

After a while, the system prompt sounded:

[Basic Backpack +1]

[The player has been detected and has a primary backpack. Is it equipped? Primary backpack has a capacity of 50 cells. Each player is limited to equip 6 backpacks. 】

"equipment."

At this time, Wang Shuo's system backpack expanded to a capacity of 70 cells.

Wang Shuo looked at the materials and found that the coarse cloth and hemp rope were gone, so he had to give up.

"If you have enough materials, you can definitely become an equipment supplier." Wang Shuo thought with joy on his face.

Before I knew it, the whole morning had passed.

Wang Shuo looked at the acid rain that was still falling outside and was a little worried: "It won't really keep raining!"

Although his food can last for a few days, who knows how many days it will last?

He couldn't help but think of the "diary prophecy", and he really had to count the rice to live.

After lunch, Wang Shuo planned to build a well.

Think silently in your mind "Building drawings using wells".

[After learning, you will learn to build water wells. Do you want to learn? 】

"yes."

[Well: 10 wood + 20 stone + 100 tiles]

Seeing that tiles were still needed, Wang Shuo thought that he would probably build a shed over the well, which was quite high-end.

[Please select the location and then confirm the construction. 】

Wang Shuo originally wanted to build it directly in the kitchen, but the system reminded him that he could not do it. He had to go to the kitchen window outside the house and place the shadow of the well on the ground. The system prompted that it would take 30 minutes, so Wang Shuo had to wait.

Out of boredom, Wang Shuo had no choice but to open the [Chat Channel].

"Is it really like what the 'diary' says? I will spend the rest of my days like this?" Wang Shuo was a little scared, but still did not resist the temptation. He comforted himself, "Just watch for a while."

"Boss, help me! It rains all night, my roof is leaking, and I've run out of wood. Whoever can give me wood is my boss."

“Stones are exchanged for food and tiles.”

"Wood is exchanged for drawings, 1 piece of wood, come as fast as you want, the quantity is not large, and it will be replaced until all is gone."

"It's not good for you to take advantage of the situation upstairs like this!"

"Are you crazy? It's crazy to exchange 1 piece of wood for a blueprint!"

"I'm not forcing you to change. Players who can't change tiles and don't have wood to repair the roof are worried right now. I'm trying to save lives."

"Water, clean water, whoever has it, I'll exchange it for supplies."

…

When Wang Shuo saw someone taking advantage of the situation, he was helpless!

The forest is so big that there are all kinds of birds, and in this precarious living environment, there is nothing that can be done about the death of fellow Taoists rather than the death of poor Taoists.

Seeing someone in need of water, his eyes lit up and he glanced at the two clay pots in the corner. They were full of water that Wang Shuo had boiled.

This is okay. Water can also be exchanged for resources.

Thinking that the well would be built soon and there should be a lot of water, he contacted the player named Tian Lin.

"I have water, what can you exchange for it?"

"I have cotton here, do you need it?"

Cotton is a good thing. It can not only make quilts, but also cotton cloth. Maybe there will be more items that need cotton in the future.

He immediately agreed: "Okay, how do you plan to change it?"

"100 cotton for 10L of water? Is that okay?"

"5L." Wang Shuo returned the price. Although he was not good at bargaining, due to the impact of acid rain, many players should now lack drinkable water. He was definitely not trying to take advantage, but to save more players.

"Okay, okay!"

The other party reluctantly agreed, and he had no choice. Several players just asked to exchange food for water. Now food is also a rare commodity, and few people are willing to exchange it.

[Cotton +100, Water -5]

With the cotton in hand, Wang Shuo saw new business opportunities.

At this moment, the system prompt sounded:

[The well is constructed. 】

Wang Shuo stopped what he was doing and walked outside the house. At this time, the eaves and the well were connected, forming a covered corridor.

When I came to the edge of the well, I fetched a bucket of water from the wooden bucket that came with the well. I found that the well water was not affected by acid rain and could be drank directly.

Wang Shuo was no longer calm. This acid rain was really...

"Bah, bah...how could I be this kind of person!" He said somewhat quibly.

But no matter how he tried to hide it, he couldn't hide his inner joy.

Then he said in the [Chat Channel]: "Friends who need clean drinking water, please come to me to exchange it. The quantity is not large, and it will be exchanged while supplies last."

"I want it, I want it."

"Boss, give me some water and I'll be your bed mat."

"Handsome guy, please take care of me. I'm 16 and the beauty of my school. I haven't had a boyfriend yet."

"Xiao Lang Hoozi, why are you showing off and pretending to be innocent? I have never seen such a woman as a big brother. Little brother, Loli Yin, Yu Jie Fan, which one do you want? I will definitely make the one you have never seen before. payment!"

…

A group of people were vying for favor here, which made Wang Shuo feel a little anxious and blushing.

"Boss, I found that you have everything that others need. Can you predict the future?"

"Do you know any inside information? Please tell me."

"Same request +1"

"Same request +2"

...

Wang Shuo couldn't help but smile bitterly. How could I know any inside information? Does "diary" count?

I have been predicted to die several times by "diary", and he basically no longer believes it.

Seeing the players making a fuss, Wang Shuo wanted to clarify, but after thinking about it, isn't this a case of trying to cover up the truth?

Wang Shuo laughed and simply ignored them, but concentrated on processing the information exchanged.

[Cotton +200, Water -100]

[Iron Ore +150, Water -150]

[Flour +100, Water -100]

[Tomato +20, Water -50]

[Iron Ore +200, Water -200]

…

[Farm Construction Drawing +1, Water -200]

[Farmland Construction Drawing +1, Water -200]

Soon, Wang Shuo exchanged 1,500 units of water. His well only had a total capacity of 2,000 units.

He stopped exchanging and left 500 units for backup.

At this moment, he had to marvel that if he wanted to be rich, he had to find a suitable time.

He got two new drawings and wanted to build them now, but the acid rain kept falling, so he had to give up.

He went back to the house and added some firewood under the kang. He lay on the kang and studied the [Task].

Task 1, upgrade the houses.

However, it requires energy, and he still doesn't know how to get energy, so he has to give up.

Mission 2, kill the elite crocodile.

He now has a sophisticated spear, and the assistance of advanced fishing nets, plus the "mud pit trap", he already has the means to deal with crocodiles, but he is not sure, after all, he has seen the ferocity of elite crocodiles.

It is 5 meters long and has abnormal defense. Just a glance can make people lose the courage to fight it. Wang Shuo has no idea how to defeat it.

Mission 3, wait for the rain to stop, what a boring task.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo suddenly came up with an idea, can he get sulfuric acid through acid rain?
